messages:
natalie_p: quick follow-up from the postmortem: recurring partial responses + reconnect storms across streaming/chat. goal: concrete owners, short mitigations, and clear rollback gates. link: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/streaming-mar2026. please volunteer for detection, server mitigations, or client guidance.

ops-bot: incident recorded: STREAM-2026-03 repeat partials & reconnect churn (sev3).

jules: i'll take server mitigations. immediate plan: add a 2s drain window to allow final chunks, implement a noisy-token cooldown (skip new streams for 60s when token error-rate > 4%), and expose recon_attempts_per_session metric. ETA: proposal by 2461120200, canary by 2461121400.

amina_sre: i'll own detection/alerts. tasks: add metric stream.partial_chunk_rate (per-cluster), sample raw small-chunk events (2% sample) for triage, and add alert when partials > 3/min per cluster. ETA: metrics+alert by 2461120800, dashboard by 2461122200.

tom_oncall: i'll handle SDK/client guidance. propose default client backoff: base 200ms, max 5s, max_retries 5, and a recommended client flag gracefulReconnect=true. also publish a short SDK note and telemetry event when SDK reduces concurrency. ETA: SDK PR by 2461123200.

natalie_p: short-term flips we can do now (hours): 1) throttle max_streams_per_token to 6, 2) enable partial alert at low sensitivity, 3) schedule short canary pause for affected cluster autoscaling. who can flip 1+3?

jules: i can flip (1) and pause autoscale for 30min, will monitor p95.

ops-bot: feature toggle applied: stream.max_streams_per_token=6 by jules.

amina_sre: detection detail: runtime will emit trace attribute early_flush=true when the first chunk is tiny (<20 bytes) and connection closes shortly after. this lets us count probable partials without client changes.

tom_oncall: SDK behaviour: if SDK observes early_flush traces >=3 in 10m, reduce concurrency by 50% for that token and tag telemetry client.partial_backoff=true. opt-out via client.enablePartialBackoff=false.

jules: draft server config i'm testing: """
stream:
  drain_window_ms: 2000
  noisy_token_cooldown_s: 60
  max_streams_per_token: 6
  soft_quit_threshold: 3
"""

amina_sre: tests: add an e2e scenario that injects small-chunk writes, assert early_flush trace and metric increment. include repro harness for infra.

natalie_p: rollback criteria: if canary p95 increases >20% or error rate increases >10% post-change, auto-revert flags. annotate feature flags with playbook link.

jules: noted, adding auto-revert: if canary p95 > baseline*1.2 for 10m revert.

tom_oncall: i'll add opt-out in SDK and a migration guide snippet to the release notes. example: client.configure({ maxConcurrentStreamsPerToken: 6, enablePartialBackoff: true });

amina_sre: propose daily 10m check-ins while flags are in rollout, then weekly until stable.

natalie_p: action items summary:
- server mitigations: owner @jules, deliverable drain window + cooldown + canary, due 2461121400
- detection & alerts: owner @amina_sre, deliverable metric + sampled traces + alert + dashboard, due 2461122200
- SDK guidance: owner @tom_oncall, deliverable SDK PR + docs + telemetry, due 2461123200

ops-bot: calendar event: Streaming Stability Triage (recurring Tue 9:30am PT) created by natalie_p.

jules: opening tracking ticket STREAM-TKT-6301 with subtasks and links to this thread. will update status after canary completes.

natalie_p: thanks everyone, keep updates brief here after each PR/flag flip. close loop in 7 days or when flags stable. :white_check_mark:
